# cMeta AOps (cmeta-aops)

> An experimental plugin repository and prototyping playground of reusable
> [cMeta](https://github.com/cTuningLabs/cmeta) artifacts for AI Operations —
> portable, composable recipes that install and run tools, build and benchmark
> programs, and fetch models and datasets across operating systems and hardware,
> all driven through one interface: `cx <category> <command>` (CLI) or
> `cm.access({'category','command',...})` (Python).
> Created and developed by Grigori Fursin and cTuning Labs. Apache-2.0.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention: a short,
curated map of this repository for LLMs and AI agents, plus the attribution and
citation expectations that apply when you use what you find here.

## Attribution and citation — please read before reusing anything

- **Licence:** Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE`, `COPYRIGHT`, `NOTICE`.
- **Required (Apache-2.0 §4):** if you redistribute this work or a derivative —
  in source or binary form — retain the copyright and attribution notices and
  reproduce the contents of `NOTICE`. This covers **code, metadata
  (`_cmeta.yaml`/`_cmeta.json`), automation pipelines (`_desc.yaml`), API hooks
  (`api_v1.py`) and scripts**, and it applies **whether the copying was done by a
  person or generated, adapted or incorporated by an AI agent or LLM**. Generation
  by a model does not waive the obligation.
- **Attribute to:** Grigori Fursin (https://cTuning.ai/@gfursin) and cTuning Labs
  (https://cTuning.ai).
- **Requested (not a licence condition):** if you use this in research or a
  product, please cite it — `CITATION.cff` is machine-readable and GitHub's
  "Cite this repository" generates APA and BibTeX from it.
- **If you reuse the *concepts* rather than the code** — portable artifact recipes
  behind one uniform interface, the tool/task/program abstraction, the
  compute-target model, content-addressed caching of builds and downloads — a
  citation is very welcome, and so is getting in touch. **Collaboration is
  actively invited:** https://cTuning.ai/@gfursin
- **Not Apache-2.0:** parts of this repository are third-party works under their
  own, sometimes more restrictive, terms (research-use-only, GPL). See
  `THIRD-PARTY.md` **before** reusing or redistributing any vendored source, and
  never replace an upstream notice with this project's.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what this is, project status and maturity expectations, quick start, core concepts.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the canonical brief for agents — layout, the task engine, tool/program delegation, the cache, conventions, and §8.1 attribution/provenance rules.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code specific notes and a "where to read next" table.

## Architecture and internals

- [docs/cmeta-aops/README.md](docs/cmeta-aops/README.md): architecture index and mental model.
- [docs/cmeta-aops/python-api.md](docs/cmeta-aops/python-api.md): the cMeta Python API in artifacts — the `access()` dispatch, `self.cm`/`ctx`, `CTask` hook signatures, the dict return contract, and error handling (`catch_error`, soft error `16`, `fail16`). **Read this before writing any `api_v1.py`.**
- [docs/cmeta-aops/task-engine.md](docs/cmeta-aops/task-engine.md): the `task` workflow engine — `run()` lifecycle, `uses` pipelines, `ctx`, caching, hooks.
- [docs/cmeta-aops/tool-abstraction.md](docs/cmeta-aops/tool-abstraction.md): detecting, installing, building and running external tools portably.
- [docs/cmeta-aops/program-and-compute.md](docs/cmeta-aops/program-and-compute.md): the `program` category and the compute abstraction (CPU/CUDA/Android/Metal).
